name: KSY Juice Blends v Citrosuco
description: Orange pulp wash (wesos) under a 3-year frame contract: KSY invoiced 758 MT of the 2019 open-price volume at the EUR 1,600/MT invoicing price without any agreed price or call-off, while Citrosuco withholds two admitted 2020 fixed-volume invoices for netting against sums KSY owes it.
